name: am-cross-border
description: Prepare Armenia 2026 corporate and personal cross-border workpapers: establish residence and permanent-establishment status, classify Armenian-source receipts, separate PE profit from non-attributed income, compute domestic nonresident withholding and reconcile capped foreign-tax credit. Covers offshore services, payment and dividend triggers, quarterly versus annual filing, electronic residence certificates and enacted future-date gates. Includes two examples and supplementary research controls for royalties, net-guaranteed consultancy, dividends, credit limitation and carryforward, and PE attribution. Use for Armenian nonresident payments, foreign companies, source of income, tax treaties and foreign tax. Supplies ordinary personal source/property, agent/no-agent reporting and departure-year methods. Maps the current SRC recipient application, authority approval and receiving-account instruction.
